 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 18/09/2023

This application for bail has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.243/2023 Police Station Nathdwara, District Rajsamand, for the offences under Section 376 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner has been implicated in the present case only with a view to pressurize him to settle some existing disputes between the parties.
Learned counsel submitted that after filing of present FIR, the parties have decided to settle their dispute amicably in the spirit of Lok Adalat.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

However,
learned counsel for the [2023:RJ-JD:30182] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-11146/2023] complainant along with the complainant present before this Court has submitted that the present FIR was lodged by the complainant and now a compromise has been arrived at between the parties and the parties have decided to settle their dispute amicably in the spirit of Lok Adalat, therefore, complainant has no objection, if the petitioner is released on bail.

entities.text: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:30182)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that the complainant present before this Court has stated that she has decided to settle the dispute amicably with the present petitioner in the spirit of Lok Adalat and she has no objection if the petitioner is released on bail and looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that petitioner-Dinesh Kumar S/o Shri Hamraj, arrested in connection with FIR No.243/2023 Police Station Nathdwara, District Rajsamand; provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- and two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
Petitioner shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 144-KshamaD/-
